claims.claim_ar: فعل التمكين «مَكَّنَّاكُمْ» يستخدم دلالة التمكّن والثبات — تصريح إلهي بالتمكين على الأرض.
claims.claim_en: The verb of establishment "makkannākum" conveys tamkin (establishment/stability) — a divine assertion of having firmly established you on the earth.
claims.needs_review_reason: The provided commentary chunk contains the lemma/concept (متمكنا) and explains 'تمكن' semantically; mapping this semantic note to the specific maani subtype (ijab_inshaa — emphatic/affirmative enunciation) is interpretive and should be reviewed against other classical balagha categorizations.

claims.claim_ar: الآية تَنْطَوِي على أسلوب حكيم/تأمّلي: بيان التمكين الإلهي ثم بيان قِلّة الشكر لدى الناس، مما يضفي أسلوبًا تأنيبيًا حكيمًا.
claims.claim_en: The verse employs an asloob hakim (wise/admonitory style): it states divine establishment and then points out people's scant gratitude, producing a measured, admonishing rhetorical effect.
